'''Selsor''' was a terrestrial astronomical object<ref name="Rules" /> located in the [[Selsor system/Legends|Selsor system]], a part of the [[Zarracina sector/Legends|Zarracina sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It featured several continents.<ref name="Rules" />

At some point during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Imperial [[cold assault stormtrooper]] unit known as the [[Snow Hawks]] conducted a successful [[Winter/Legends|winter]] campaign in the frozen terrain on Selsor's primary continent.<ref name="Rules" />

==Behind the scenes==
Selsor was introduced in ''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]'', a [[1997]] [[West End Games]] sourcebook authored by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Rules" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Selsor [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body Selsor, in grid square O-14.<ref name="TEA" />
